entries.label: Seq 5 (Beyonder Threshold)
entries.text: Divination from Seq 9–7 Beyonders is at -6 unless the diviner has a direct link (true name + blood or hair), which reduces the penalty to -3.

entries.label: Seq 4 (Demigod)
entries.text: Divination from any weaker-Sequence Beyonder is at -10. Equal-Sequence divination is at -3. Only a critical success (3–4) can succeed — the -10 penalty cannot be offset by skill alone.

entries.label: Seq 3 (Saint)
entries.text: Only demigods (Seq 4+) or those with a special connection can attempt to divine you. Weaker Sequences are at -10 and only a critical success (3–4) can succeed — the penalty cannot be offset by skill alone.

entries.label: Seq 2 (Angel)
entries.text: Divination is at -10 and requires the diviner to possess your true honorific name and an intimate possession. The mere attempt may draw your attention — the GM decides when and how.

entries.label: Seq 6–9
entries.text: No passive penalty applies. The Sequence Advantage rule (below) only affects targets at Seq 5+.
